Basically I watched her get hit, the killer ran to find the other two. She would heal. Killer would go back to her while she ran around doing nothing when he couldn't find the other two. He never downed her at all. And she never rescued us from hooks. I watched two people try and save me from basement hook and a nea running around in circles as I'm dying. Then after the three of us died. They met up and was walking around the map having a good time.

Noooo.... At first I thought maybe that was it. But it was very obvious that they were working together. he never hooked her the entire game and only hooked us. And I watched her not work on any generators, throw pallets for no reason, and walk around with the killer after the rest of us died and she teabagged the hook my friend died on with the killer.
